answer: Proof-of-work functions serve as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to expend computational signal to solve cryptographic puzzles. Similar to the geologic compression of shale, the energy density required to validate a block creates a non-trivial cost barrier for attackers. This economic friction prevents mass-identity proliferation, ensuring that even a rhythmic sonnet of malicious traffic cannot overwhelm the network without significant, verifiable capital expenditure.
